name: zha-device-handlers-b139f815-blind30-ots
instr:
# ZHA quirks collection: diagnosing thirty regressions without a test suite

Everything below was observed on a running installation after a routine update, with no configuration change on my side. The repository has received 30 separate undocumented edits. The same equipment is still on the air, speaking the same protocol it always did, but numbers now arrive wrong, alarms stay silent, shades travel the wrong way, keys on the remotes do nothing, and options written from the app no longer land.

Start with the plain readings that equipment sends in unprompted. A mains-powered wall unit that measures its own internal temperature of 25 degrees used to surface 2500 in hundredths and now surfaces 2525, while the lowest and highest figures it has recorded still pass through untouched. A mains socket that measures consumption has the mirror-image trouble: an instantaneous demand of 25000 is surfaced verbatim instead of being scaled down to 25, and its cumulative delivered-energy total of 25 now arrives as 0, because the scaling that belongs to the demand figure is applied to everything else instead. A combined presence-and-brightness sensor converts its raw readings wrongly in two separate ways at once: every reading is one step too high across the whole range, so pitch darkness that used to surface as 1 now surfaces as 2, and independently of that the brightest raw readings are grossly overstated, with a raw 34299 that should convert to 26989 coming back as an enormous number.
